edits.text: 1. PURCHASE PRICE. The aggregate purchase price for the Shares (the “Purchase Price”) shall be determined by the Parties following completion of financial and liability diligence and set forth in a written amendment to this Agreement signed by both Parties. The Purchase Price shall be determined on a cash-free, debt-free basis, subject to a customary adjustment for the amount by which Closing Working Capital is greater or less than an agreed working-capital peg. The Parties shall agree in writing on the definitions of cash, debt, Closing Working Capital, and transaction expenses, the working-capital peg, and the procedures and timing for preparing and resolving any purchase-price adjustment. At Closing, Buyer shall pay in cash the Purchase Price less the Escrow Amount. An amount equal to fifteen percent (15%) of the Purchase Price (the “Escrow Amount”) shall be deposited at Closing with an escrow agent under an escrow agreement to be agreed by the Parties and held for eighteen (18) months after Closing to secure indemnification claims, with any undisputed remaining balance released to Seller promptly upon expiration of that period. No Party shall be obligated to consummate the purchase and sale unless the Purchase Price and the foregoing matters are agreed in a written amendment signed by both Parties.
edits.name: Purchase Price
